name: China Sciences Ecorizon Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: China Sciences Ecorizon Tech Co., Ltd. provides waste treatment and disposal services. The company is involved in the investment, construction, and operation of domestic waste incineration power generation projects; generation of electricity, heat, and biogas; and provision of heating services to industrial enterprises. It also offers treatment and disposal of various types of urban waste, such as household waste, kitchen waste, urban sludge, and medical waste. In addition, the company provides operation management consulting and on-site supervision services related to waste treatment and disposal projects.
